ImageDescription.value: A wide eye-level view of Pulangbato Falls located in the mountainous region of Valencia, Negros Oriental, Philippines. The waterfall cascades into a natural plunge pool enclosed by dramatic cliff walls composed of dark basalt columns and reddish-orange mineral deposits caused by sulfur from nearby Mount Talinis. The pool and surrounding riverbed feature scattered rocks covered in the same vivid orange-red coating. Visitors are seen relaxing along the rocky banks and enjoying the scenery. A dense canopy of tropical rainforest vegetation, including tree ferns and lush green vines, frames the top and sides of the waterfall basin.

ImageDescription.value: The beautiful Sarasah Gaduik Waterfall is located in the campus area of Andalas University, Padang, West Sumatra. This tiered waterfall flows down over black rocks surrounded by dense tropical forest that creates a cool and peaceful atmosphere. The clear water and green scenery make it a favorite nature spot for students and visitors. Sarasah Gaduik represents the natural beauty of West Sumatra and reminds us to preserve forests and waterfalls as important ecosystems and educational tourist destinations for future generations.
